body.zh: 图像差分在对应位置和通道比较读数。带符号的差保留变化方向，绝对差保留变化大小。数值和位置是不同信息，图像算术逐位置执行。
body.en: Image differencing compares corresponding locations and channels. Signed difference retains direction; absolute difference retains size. Values and positions are distinct; image arithmetic acts at matching locations.

body.zh: \[d=O-R,\qquad D=|d|\]
body.en: \[d=O-R,\qquad D=|d|\]

body.zh: O 为观测图，R 为参照图。d 和 D 分别表示对应位置、对应通道的带符号差和绝对差。
body.en: O is the observed image and R the reference. At matching positions and channels, d is the signed difference and D its magnitude.

body.zh: 常见误解：只留下正变化，或把负数显示成黑色就认为没有变化。
body.en: Common misconception: Keeping only positive changes, or treating clipped negative display values as no change.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md PDF pp22–26; L3 PDF pp6–7 (point operations); absolute value is mathematical support
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md PDF pp22–26; L3 PDF pp6–7 (point operations); absolute value is mathematical support

body.zh: 逐位置比较需要同一场景位置对应。这里约定输出 (x,y) 读取输入 (x+dx,y+dy)，x 向右、y 向下为正；有限图像之外的值来自边界假设。
body.en: Pointwise comparison requires corresponding scene locations. Here output (x,y) reads input (x+dx,y+dy), with x right and y down. Outside values follow an explicit boundary assumption.

body.zh: \[\begin{gathered}S(x,y)=O(x+d_x,y+d_y)\\D(x,y)=|S(x,y)-R(x,y)|\end{gathered}\]
body.en: \[\begin{gathered}S(x,y)=O(x+d_x,y+d_y)\\D(x,y)=|S(x,y)-R(x,y)|\end{gathered}\]

body.zh: S 是按偏移 (dx, dy) 读取的观测图，R 是参照图，D 是对齐后的绝对差。
body.en: S is the observed image read at offset (dx, dy), R is the reference, and D is the aligned absolute difference.

body.zh: 常见误解：给像素值加 dx 就是在移动图像。 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>
body.en: Common misconception: Adding dx to pixel values moves the image. <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md PDF pp22–26; spatial-read convention is a declared task assumption
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md PDF pp22–26; spatial-read convention is a declared task assumption

body.zh: 测量输出保留变化量，判定根据任务给定的准则将证据转为标记。阈值比较不是对物体语义或缺陷成因的推断。
body.en: Measurements retain change values; a task criterion turns evidence into a decision mask. Thresholding does not infer object meaning or defect cause.

body.zh: \[M(x,y)=\begin{cases}1,&D(x,y)>\tau\\0,&D(x,y)\le\tau\end{cases}\]
body.en: \[M(x,y)=\begin{cases}1,&D(x,y)>\tau\\0,&D(x,y)\le\tau\end{cases}\]

body.zh: D 是对齐后的差异大小，τ 是容差，M 是超差标记。恰好等于容差时取 0。
body.en: D is the aligned difference magnitude, τ the tolerance, and M the flag. Equality produces 0.

body.zh: 常见误解：测量值本身就是缺陷类别，或者零与非零足以处理所有读数波动。
body.en: Common misconception: Treating measurements as defect classes, or assuming every nonzero change must fail.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md image arrays; L3 point operations; inspection/tolerance is a controlled application
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md image arrays; L3 point operations; inspection/tolerance is a controlled application

body.zh: 线性局部运算把邻域的对应读数与权重相乘后相加。位置和符号有意义；对恒定输入，权重和决定输出增益。
body.en: A linear local operation sums position-matched weighted readings. Positions and signs matter; the weight sum determines constant-input gain.

body.zh: \[\begin{aligned}Y(p)={}&w_-I(p-d)+w_0I(p)\\&+w_+I(p+d)\end{aligned}\]
body.en: \[\begin{aligned}Y(p)={}&w_-I(p-d)+w_0I(p)\\&+w_+I(p+d)\end{aligned}\]

body.zh: p 是当前位置，d 是读取方向，三个权重依次对应前方、中心和后方的读数。
body.en: p is the current position and d the read direction. The weights multiply the preceding, centre and following samples.

body.zh: 常见误解：交换左右权重不会改变结果，或者所有权重都必须为正并且总和为 1。
body.en: Common misconception: Swapping side weights has no effect, or all filters must have positive unit-sum weights.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp8–18,21–23
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp8–18,21–23

body.zh: 若二维核是两个一维权重向量的外积，可以先后沿两轴计算，减少每个像素的加权次数。非可分离核不能直接这样替代；有限图像要保持相同边界与输出域。 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>
body.en: An outer-product kernel can be applied as consecutive 1D passes, reducing weighted samples per pixel. Nonseparable kernels cannot be replaced this way, and boundaries/domains must agree. <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>

body.zh: u 和 v 是两轴偏移。此式是两轴都使用同一组一维权重 h 时的外积。
body.en: u and v are offsets along the two axes. This is the outer product when both axes use the same one-dimensional weights h.

body.zh: 常见误解：两条轴各处理一次再相加就等于二维平均。
body.en: Common misconception: Adding independent axis outputs is a 2D average.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp37–40
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp37–40

body.zh: 互相关将书写核按中心对齐邻域，保持核的书写方向，计算对应元素乘积之和。核尺寸决定支持域，权重决定响应。
body.en: Correlation centres a written kernel without reversing it and sums matching products. Kernel size determines support; weights determine response.

body.zh: \[\begin{gathered}Y(x,y)=\sum_{u,v}K(u,v)\,I(x+u,y+v)\end{gathered}\]
body.en: \[\begin{gathered}Y(x,y)=\sum_{u,v}K(u,v)\,I(x+u,y+v)\end{gathered}\]

body.zh: K 是核，I 是输入图像。求和遍历核覆盖的所有偏移 (u, v)。
body.en: K is the kernel and I the input image. The sum runs over all offsets (u, v) covered by the kernel.

body.zh: 常见误解：权重乘完之后还要再平均一次，或表中每行是一整张新图。
body.en: Common misconception: Averaging after weighting, or treating each table row as a separate full image.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp9–18,31–35
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp9–18,31–35

body.zh: 数学离散卷积使用反转的核，相比互相关需将核旋转 180 度。非对称核揭示方向差别；对称核会隐藏它。
body.en: Discrete mathematical convolution reverses the kernel: rotate it 180 degrees relative to correlation. Asymmetric kernels reveal the difference; symmetric ones hide it.

body.zh: \[\begin{gathered}(I*K)(x,y)\\=\sum_{u,v}K(u,v)\,I(x-u,y-v)\end{gathered}\]
body.en: \[\begin{gathered}(I*K)(x,y)\\=\sum_{u,v}K(u,v)\,I(x-u,y-v)\end{gathered}\]

body.zh: I 是输入图像，K 是核。式中的负偏移对应核的翻转。
body.en: I is the input and K the kernel. Negative offsets correspond to reversing the kernel.

body.zh: 常见误解：对称模糊结果一致，就认为卷积和互相关没有区别。
body.en: Common misconception: Assuming convolution and correlation are identical because symmetric blurs agree.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp17–18
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp17–18

body.zh: 离散高斯样本可归一化为平滑核，尺度和支持域影响响应。非锐化增强把带符号的高频细节加回原图；不能保证恢复真实场景。
body.en: Normalised sampled Gaussian weights form a smoother whose scale and support affect response. Unsharp enhancement adds signed high-frequency detail back to the original; it does not guarantee scene recovery.

body.zh: \[D=I-S,\qquad E=I+\alpha D\]
body.en: \[D=I-S,\qquad E=I+\alpha D\]

body.zh: I 是原图，S 是平滑图。D 保留细节的正负，α 控制加回多少细节，E 是增强结果。
body.en: I is the original image and S the smoothed image. D retains signed detail, α controls how much is added back, and E is the enhanced image.

body.zh: 常见误解：平滑只删除噪声，或增强可以用绝对差代替带符号差。
body.en: Common misconception: Smoothing removes only noise, or absolute difference can replace signed detail for enhancement.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp24–28,35
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp24–28,35

body.zh: 有限图像没有图外观测，补边只是对图外的一种猜测，各适合不同的材料：补 0 最简单，但可能造出黑边；复制最近边缘对普通照片通常较自然；周期延续把左右、上下相接，适合可以无缝平铺的纹理，不适合普通照片；镜像延续让边缘两侧对称，常能减少人工边界。没有一种规则永远最好。valid 只保留完整邻域，因此输出尺寸依核支持缩小。
body.en: Finite images have no outside observations, so padding is a guess about the outside, each suiting different material: zero is simplest but can create dark borders; replicating the nearest edge is usually natural for ordinary photographs; periodic continuation joins left to right and top to bottom, suiting seamlessly tileable textures but not ordinary photographs; reflection mirrors the edge and often reduces artificial borders. No rule is always best. Valid output keeps full neighbourhoods and shrinks with support.

body.zh: \[\begin{gathered}W_{\mathrm{valid}}=W-2r_x\\H_{\mathrm{valid}}=H-2r_y\end{gathered}\]
body.en: \[\begin{gathered}W_{\mathrm{valid}}=W-2r_x\\H_{\mathrm{valid}}=H-2r_y\end{gathered}\]

body.zh: W、H 是原图宽高，rx、ry 是邻域在两轴上的半径。图像足够大时，两端各裁掉一个半径。
body.en: W and H are the input dimensions, and rx and ry are the neighbourhood radii. For a sufficiently large image, one radius is cropped at each end.

body.zh: 常见误解：所有补边只影响外观，或保持原宽高的补边等于 valid。
body.en: Common misconception: Padding only affects appearance, or same-size padding is equivalent to valid output.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp41–45
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp41–45

body.zh: 图像梯度由两条空间轴的偏导数组成，离散差分近似它们。分量的正负保留变化方向，核约定与坐标方向必须明确。
body.en: An image gradient contains derivatives along both spatial axes, approximated by differences. Signs retain direction; kernel and coordinate conventions must be explicit.

body.zh: \[\nabla I=(g_x,g_y)\]
body.en: \[\nabla I=(g_x,g_y)\]

body.zh: gx、gy 分别是沿 x 和 y 方向的带符号变化率。在离散图像中用差分核近似。
body.en: gx and gy are the signed rates of change along x and y. Difference kernels approximate them on sampled images.

body.zh: 常见误解：把同一张变化图当作两个方向，或者忽略负响应。
body.en: Common misconception: Using one response for both axes, or discarding negative responses.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp29–30; L5 PDF pp39–42
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp29–30; L5 PDF pp39–42

body.zh: Sobel 沿一轴差分、沿垂直轴平滑，组成二维方向核。梯度长度为 sqrt(gx²+gy²)，区别于有符号相加。尺度、噪声和边界都会影响响应。
body.en: Sobel combines a derivative along one axis with smoothing along the other. Gradient length is sqrt(gx²+gy²), not signed addition. Scale, noise and boundaries affect responses.

body.zh: gx 和 gy 是两个带符号的 Sobel 响应，M 是梯度强度。
body.en: gx and gy are the signed Sobel responses, and M is the gradient magnitude.

body.zh: 常见误解：应沿求导轴再次平均，或用 gx+gy 代替长度。
body.en: Common misconception: Smoothing along the derivative axis, or replacing length with gx+gy.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp29–30; L5 PDF pp39–42
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp29–30; L5 PDF pp39–42

body.zh: 视觉流水线将已有测量、预处理和判定模块组合。每个模块有输入输出含义；顺序和边界影响结果，最终响应仍受任务假设限制。
body.en: A visual pipeline composes measurements, preprocessing and decisions with explicit input/output meaning. Order and boundaries matter, and task assumptions limit the final response.

body.zh: \[\begin{gathered}M=\sqrt{g_x^2+g_y^2}\\B=\begin{cases}1,&M>\tau\\0,&M\le\tau\end{cases}\end{gathered}\]
body.en: \[\begin{gathered}M=\sqrt{g_x^2+g_y^2}\\B=\begin{cases}1,&M>\tau\\0,&M\le\tau\end{cases}\end{gathered}\]

body.zh: gx 和 gy 是预处理后的方向响应，M 是强度，τ 是阈值，B 标记严格超标的位置。
body.en: gx and gy are directional responses after preprocessing, M is their magnitude, τ is the threshold, and B marks strict exceedance.

body.zh: 常见误解：把原图直接接入边缘检测，再靠阈值弥补所有干扰。
body.en: Common misconception: Feeding raw input to edge measurement and relying on thresholding to remove all nuisance.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md common filters and composition; controlled scanner application
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md common filters and composition; controlled scanner application

body.zh: 余弦波可写成 A cos(2π(kx/N+p))。k 控制整行周期数，A 控制幅度，p 控制相位；这里相位以周为单位。波形的负值仍是有效计算数据。
body.en: A cosine wave is A cos(2π(kx/N+p)): k controls cycles per row, A amplitude and p phase. This interface measures phase in turns. Negative wave values remain valid data.

body.zh: \[s[n]=A\cos\!\left(2\pi\left(\frac{kn}{N}+p\right)\right)\]
body.en: \[s[n]=A\cos\!\left(2\pi\left(\frac{kn}{N}+p\right)\right)\]

body.zh: n 是采样位置，N 是行长，k 是整行的周期数，A 是振幅，p 是以周为单位的相位。
body.en: n is the sample position, N the row length, k the number of cycles across the row, A the amplitude, and p the phase in turns.

body.zh: 常见误解：频率是统一加到每个位置的偏移。
body.en: Common misconception: Frequency is an offset added to every position.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp7–21; turns are the declared mathematical unit
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp7–21; turns are the declared mathematical unit

body.zh: 本游戏在离散行上计算 \(P(k,p)=\frac1N\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}x[n]\cos\!\left(2\pi\left(\frac{kn}{N}+p\right)\right)\)，n 遍历全部 N 个位置。k 表示整行周期数，p 以周为单位。平均投影不会因样本数量翻倍而自动翻倍。
body.en: This game computes \(P(k,p)=\frac1N\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}x[n]\cos\!\left(2\pi\left(\frac{kn}{N}+p\right)\right)\) over all N row positions. k counts row cycles and p is in turns. Averaging prevents sample count alone from scaling the projection.

body.zh: 异频抵消要求参考波与离散周期匹配、覆盖完整周期。非整数周期、噪声和频率偏差会影响测量，不能把单路零响应等同于没有该频率。
body.en: Cross-frequency cancellation requires matched discrete periodic references over complete periods. Non-integer cycles, noise and frequency mismatch affect the measurement; a single zero projection does not establish absence.

body.zh: 常见误解：探针自己有波形就能测量，或一次零响应等于频率不存在。
body.en: Common misconception: The basis alone measures the signal, or one zero response proves absence.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier transform PDF pp18–24
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier transform PDF pp18–24

body.zh: 对于已知频率的理想单频信号，\(x[n]=A\cos(\theta_n+\phi)=A\cos\phi\cos\theta_n-A\sin\phi\sin\theta_n\)，\(\theta_n=2\pi kn/N\)。未知幅度与相位可以改写成两个独立系数；正交参考方向使两个投影互不干扰。
body.en: For an ideal sinusoid of known frequency, \(x[n]=A\cos(\theta_n+\phi)=A\cos\phi\cos\theta_n-A\sin\phi\sin\theta_n\), with \(\theta_n=2\pi kn/N\). Unknown amplitude and phase become two independent coefficients; orthogonal reference directions separate their measurements.

body.zh: 本游戏取 \(\mathrm{Re}=\operatorname{mean}_n(x[n]\cos\theta_n)\)、\(\mathrm{Im}=\operatorname{mean}_n(-x[n]\sin\theta_n)\)。对孤立的匹配整数频率，且不是直流或偶数长度的奈奎斯特频率，有 \(\mathrm{Re}=\frac A2\cos\phi\)、\(\mathrm{Im}=\frac A2\sin\phi\)，因此峰值幅度 \(A=2\sqrt{\mathrm{Re}^2+\mathrm{Im}^2}\)，\(\phi=\operatorname{atan2}(\mathrm{Im},\mathrm{Re})\)（弧度）。系数长度不能直接当作 A；A=0 时相位无定义。
body.en: This game uses \(\mathrm{Re}=\operatorname{mean}_n(x[n]\cos\theta_n)\) and \(\mathrm{Im}=\operatorname{mean}_n(-x[n]\sin\theta_n)\). For an isolated matching integer-bin sinusoid away from DC and even-length Nyquist, \(\mathrm{Re}=\frac A2\cos\phi\) and \(\mathrm{Im}=\frac A2\sin\phi\), so peak amplitude \(A=2\sqrt{\mathrm{Re}^2+\mathrm{Im}^2}\) and \(\phi=\operatorname{atan2}(\mathrm{Im},\mathrm{Re})\), in radians. Coefficient length is not A; at A=0 phase is undefined.

body.zh: 两路分量各自汇总整行 N 个样本，不是只读两个原始点。直流和奈奎斯特的正弦参考在采样点上为零，只剩一条实数方向；未知频率仍需探测不同频率。
body.en: Each component aggregates all N samples, not two raw points. At DC and Nyquist the sine reference vanishes on the sample grid, leaving one real direction. Unknown frequency still requires probing different frequencies.

body.zh: 常见误解：重复同一投影可以补齐相位，或系数幅度足够重建原图。
body.en: Common misconception: Duplicating one projection recovers phase, or magnitude alone reconstructs the image.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp18–24,33–34
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp18–24,33–34

body.zh: 离散频谱保留全部基函数投影。这里前向按 N 归一化，DC 位于索引 0；实信号的 k 与 N−k 系数互为共轭，索引应按周期解释。
body.en: The discrete spectrum retains all basis projections. This convention normalises forward coefficients by N and stores DC at index 0. For real signals, k and N−k are conjugate and indices are periodic.

body.zh: \[C[k]=\frac1N\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}x[n]e^{-i2\pi kn/N}\]
body.en: \[C[k]=\frac1N\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}x[n]e^{-i2\pi kn/N}\]

body.zh: N 是行长，n 是采样位置，k 是频率索引，i 是虚数单位。取 k=0 时得到整行平均值。
body.en: N is the row length, n the sample position, k the frequency index, and i the imaginary unit. At k=0 the coefficient equals the row mean.

body.zh: 常见误解：把取样位置当作频率索引，或只保留一半而不说明如何恢复。
body.en: Common misconception: Confusing sample positions with frequency indices, or discarding half the data without a recovery rule.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp18–26
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp18–26

body.zh: 逆变换把各频率按复数系数组合。这里前向除以 N、逆向直接求和；实输出为 Σ(Re·cos−Im·sin)。只保留幅度通常不能还原原有空间关系。
body.en: Inverse transformation combines frequencies using complex coefficients. This convention divides forward by N and sums inverse terms: Σ(Re·cos−Im·sin) for real output. Magnitude alone usually loses spatial relationships.

body.zh: \[\begin{gathered}\theta_{kn}=\frac{2\pi kn}{N}\\x[n]=\sum_{k=0}^{N-1}\bigl(\operatorname{Re}C[k]\cos\theta_{kn}\\-\operatorname{Im}C[k]\sin\theta_{kn}\bigr)\end{gathered}\]
body.en: \[\begin{gathered}\theta_{kn}=\frac{2\pi kn}{N}\\x[n]=\sum_{k=0}^{N-1}\bigl(\operatorname{Re}C[k]\cos\theta_{kn}\\-\operatorname{Im}C[k]\sin\theta_{kn}\bigr)\end{gathered}\]

body.zh: n 是重建位置，N 是行长，C[k] 是前向已归一化的系数。对全部频率求和得到实信号。
body.en: n is the reconstruction position, N the row length, and C[k] the normalised forward coefficient. Summing all frequency contributions recovers the real signal.

body.zh: 常见误解：逆向也要平均，或者把虚部符号照搬为同相余弦。
body.en: Common misconception: Averaging in both directions, or using the wrong imaginary contribution.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier transform and magnitude/phase PDF pp18–34
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier transform and magnitude/phase PDF pp18–34

body.zh: 平移可在保留频谱幅度时改变相位。幅度和相位共同决定重建，交换相位会改变结构；频谱为零的位置没有可定义的相位方向。
body.en: Translation can change phase while retaining magnitudes. Both determine reconstruction; phase exchange changes structure. Zero coefficients have no defined phase direction.

body.zh: 在频率 k 上，系数的模是幅度，φk 是相位。模为零时相位无定义。
body.en: At frequency k, the coefficient magnitude gives its size and φk gives its phase. Phase is undefined at zero magnitude.

body.zh: 常见误解：幅度就是可重建的完整频谱，虚部是无用噪声。
body.en: Common misconception: Magnitude is the complete reconstructible spectrum and imaginary components are noise.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp33–34
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp33–34

body.zh: 傅里叶变换是线性的。对 a+ib，可分别计算 F(a)、F(b)，再组成 F(a)+iF(b)；乘 i 会交换实虚贡献并改变其中一项符号。
body.en: The Fourier transform is linear: F(a+ib)=F(a)+iF(b). Multiplying by i exchanges real/imaginary contributions and negates one component.

body.zh: \[\begin{gathered}(a+ib)(\cos\theta-i\sin\theta)\\=(a\cos\theta+b\sin\theta)\\+i(b\cos\theta-a\sin\theta)\end{gathered}\]
body.en: \[\begin{gathered}(a+ib)(\cos\theta-i\sin\theta)\\=(a\cos\theta+b\sin\theta)\\+i(b\cos\theta-a\sin\theta)\end{gathered}\]

body.zh: a、b 分别是一个复数样本的实部和虚部，θ 是参考波角度。逐样本计算并取平均，得到该频率的系数。
body.en: a and b are the real and imaginary parts of a sample, and θ is the reference angle. Averaging these products over the samples gives the coefficient.

body.zh: 常见误解：第二条轴只需处理第一条轴的实部。
body.en: Common misconception: The second axis needs only the first pass’s real part.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier representation and linearity; complex arithmetic is supplied support
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier representation and linearity; complex arithmetic is supplied support

body.zh: 二维 DFT 可分解为两条轴的完整复数一维变换。每条频率轴描述相应空间方向的变化；本约定总前向归一化为 1/(WH)。
body.en: The 2D DFT separates into complete complex 1D transforms along both axes. Frequency axes correspond to spatial variation; this convention normalises forward by 1/(WH).

body.zh: \[\begin{gathered}\theta_{uvxy}=2\pi\left(\frac{ux}{W}+\frac{vy}{H}\right)\\C[u,v]=\frac1{WH}\sum_{x=0}^{W-1}\sum_{y=0}^{H-1}z[x,y]e^{-i\theta_{uvxy}}\end{gathered}\]
body.en: \[\begin{gathered}\theta_{uvxy}=2\pi\left(\frac{ux}{W}+\frac{vy}{H}\right)\\C[u,v]=\frac1{WH}\sum_{x=0}^{W-1}\sum_{y=0}^{H-1}z[x,y]e^{-i\theta_{uvxy}}\end{gathered}\]

body.zh: W、H 是宽高，x、y 是空间索引，u、v 是相应的频率索引，z 是复数输入。
body.en: W and H are the dimensions, x and y are spatial indices, u and v are their frequency indices, and z is the complex input.

body.zh: 常见误解：第二次仍沿原来的行处理，或不恢复原图轴顺序。
body.en: Common misconception: Transforming original rows twice, or failing to restore axis order.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp25–32
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp25–32

body.zh: 频域滤波以逐频率增益乘复数系数再逆变换。低通保留接近零的频率，高通去掉低频，带通保留一个范围；实输出要求增益与共轭对称一致。
body.en: Frequency filtering multiplies complex coefficients by gains before inversion. Low-pass keeps frequencies near zero, high-pass removes low frequencies, and band-pass keeps a range. Real output requires conjugate-consistent gains.

body.zh: \[C_{\mathrm{out}}[k]=g[k]C[k]\]
body.en: \[C_{\mathrm{out}}[k]=g[k]C[k]\]

body.zh: g[k] 是频率 k 的增益，同一个实数增益同时乘到系数的实部和虚部。
body.en: g[k] is the gain at frequency k. The same real gain scales the real and imaginary components.

body.zh: 常见误解：只调整实部，或者负索引天然属于低频。
body.en: Common misconception: Adjusting only real components, or treating every negative index as low frequency.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp38–43
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp38–43

body.zh: 硬频率截止对应振荡的空间核，可能在突变附近产生振铃。渐变过渡改变空间响应，以额外平滑换取不同的振荡表现；应检查未截断数值。
body.en: Hard frequency cutoffs correspond to oscillatory spatial kernels and can ring near discontinuities. Tapering changes that response, trading additional smoothing for different oscillation behaviour. Inspect unclipped values.

body.zh: \[y=\mathcal F^{-1}\!\left(g\cdot\mathcal F(x)\right)\]
body.en: \[y=\mathcal F^{-1}\!\left(g\cdot\mathcal F(x)\right)\]

body.zh: x 是输入，g 是频率增益，y 是重建结果。g 的突然跳变可在空间突变附近产生波纹。
body.en: x is the input, g the frequency gain, and y the reconstruction. An abrupt jump in g can cause ripples near spatial discontinuities.

body.zh: 常见误解：频域低通总是没有副作用，显示中没看到过冲就不存在。
body.en: Common misconception: Low-pass has no side effects, or invisible clipped overshoot does not exist.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp44–47
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp44–47

body.zh: 空间卷积对应频域复数逐点乘积。离散有限实现需匹配周期/补边约定、核原点、输出域和归一化；本例对每行使用周期卷积。
body.en: Spatial convolution corresponds to pointwise complex frequency multiplication. Finite implementations must match periodic/padding conventions, kernel origin, output domain and normalisation. This task uses circular row convolution.

body.zh: \[\mathcal F(x*h)[k]=N\,\mathcal F(x)[k]\,\mathcal F(h)[k]\]
body.en: \[\mathcal F(x*h)[k]=N\,\mathcal F(x)[k]\,\mathcal F(h)[k]\]

body.zh: x 是输入，h 是单位脉冲响应，星号表示周期卷积。前向变换除以行长 N，因此频谱乘积需要乘 N。
body.en: x is the input, h the unit impulse response, and the star denotes circular convolution. The forward transform divides by row length N, so the spectral product is multiplied by N.

body.zh: 常见误解：把周期频域结果与零边界卷积比较，认为差异就是算法错误。
body.en: Common misconception: Comparing periodic frequency processing with zero-boundary convolution as if they were the same problem.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp35–37
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp35–37

body.zh: 二维重建把横向与纵向的频率索引依次变回空间坐标。中间结果可以是复数，两路都必须保留。
body.en: Two-dimensional synthesis reconstructs spatial positions along each axis in turn. The intermediate result can be complex, so keep both components.

body.zh:
\[I=\mathcal F_y^{-1}(\mathcal F_x^{-1}(X))\]

沿一轴重建后，结果仍可能有实部和虚部，另一轴要一起读。逐行重建采用直接求和，补回前向归一化。
body.en:
\[I=\mathcal F_y^{-1}(\mathcal F_x^{-1}(X))\]

After reconstructing along one axis, retain both components for the other. Row synthesis sums directly to undo the forward normalisation.

body.zh: 常见误解：一次逐行重建就能恢复整幅图，或中间虚部可以直接丢掉。
body.en: Common misconception: One row pass reconstructs the whole image, or the intermediate imaginary component can be discarded.

body.zh: 出处：04-fourier.md，二维傅里叶变换与反变换。
body.en: Source: 04-fourier.md, 2D Fourier transform and inverse.

body.zh: 周期干扰常集中于特定频率。选择性增益可以抑制它，但与这些频率重叠的有用信号也会被抑制；噪声识别、边界与频率模型是任务假设。
body.en: Periodic interference can concentrate at selected frequencies. Selective gains suppress it but also remove useful signal at those frequencies. Interference identity, boundaries and frequency models are assumptions.

body.zh: C 是输入频谱，g 是二维频率增益，Y 是处理后的频谱。对实图，成对频率使用相同的实数增益。
body.en: C is the input spectrum, g the two-dimensional gain, and Y the filtered spectrum. For real images, paired frequencies receive the same real gain.

body.zh: 常见误解：任何平滑都只删噪声，或指定频率的抑制等于自动理解哪些像素是噪声。 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>
body.en: Common misconception: Every smoother removes only noise, or suppressing specified frequencies automatically identifies nuisance pixels. <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp25–32,38–47; controlled known-frequency application
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp25–32,38–47; controlled known-frequency application

body.zh: 坐标从 0 开始，x 向右、y 向下。数值表中每格保存读数或位置；点击可查看其原值。
body.en: Coordinates start at zero, x right and y down. A cell stores a reading or a position; select it to inspect the original value.

body.zh: \[0\le x<W,\qquad 0\le y<H\]
body.en: \[0\le x<W,\qquad 0\le y<H\]

body.zh: W、H 为图像宽高，像素坐标取整数。左上角是 (0, 0)。
body.en: W and H are the image dimensions, and pixel coordinates are integers. The top-left corner is (0, 0).

body.zh: 图像采样格，包含一个或多个通道读数。显示亮度限于 0–1，计算值可超出该区间。
body.en: An image sample location with one or more channel readings. Display is clipped to 0–1, but stored values may lie outside it.

body.zh: v 是原始读数，b 是显示亮度。裁切只发生在显示时。
body.en: v is the stored reading and b the displayed brightness. Clipping applies to the display.

body.zh: 输出只由同一位置的输入读数决定。负片反转亮暗，邻居的读数不参与。课程来源：COMP90086 L3 的像素算子。
body.en: Each output depends only on the input at the corresponding location. A negative reverses brightness without involving neighbouring readings. Source: COMP90086 L3, pixel operators.

body.zh: 对亮度做仿射变换时，增益乘在输入上，偏移加在结果上。显示可能裁去超范围的值。课程来源：COMP90086 L3 的像素算子。
body.en: In an affine brightness transform, gain multiplies the input and offset adds to the result. Display may clip out-of-range values. Source: COMP90086 L3, pixel operators.

body.zh: 从输出坐标出发，要加上这个向量才能找到读取的输入坐标。课程来源：COMP90086 L2 的图像坐标。
body.en: Add this vector to the output coordinate to find the input coordinate to read. Source: COMP90086 L2, image coordinates.

body.zh: 绝对差之和给候选对齐一个分数。只有在照明和观察区域可比较时，较小的分数才是对齐的证据。课程来源：COMP90086 L2 的图像比较。
body.en: Summed absolute differences score a candidate alignment. A lower score is evidence of alignment when lighting and the compared regions are comparable. Source: COMP90086 L2, image comparison.
